name: @metorial/toggl
description: Track time with Toggl Track. Create, inspect, update, stop, and delete time entries. Manage projects, clients, tags, and tasks, and retrieve individual project or client details. Discover available workspaces, inspect your account, and list workspace members. Generate summary and detailed reports with date ranges, resource filters, billable status, and detailed-report pagination. Tasks and some billing or reporting capabilities require an eligible plan.
